description:
Simalytics is a focused companion for Simkl that keeps your movies, TV shows, and anime organized in one place.

TRACK YOUR LIBRARY
Browse your watching, completed, planned, on-hold, and dropped titles in clean lists or poster grids. Sort your collection and open rich detail pages for every title.

STAY ON TOP OF EPISODES
Keep track of your next episodes in Up Next. Browse seasons and anime episode ranges, resume from your latest watched season, and mark episodes watched without losing your place.

DISCOVER MORE
Explore trending movies, shows, and anime. Search the catalog, view ratings and cast details, and find where supported titles are available to watch.

SYNC WITH SIMKL
Sign in with your Simkl account to sync watchlists, progress, and ratings across devices. Choose your default launch tab, use 5-star or 10-point ratings, blur episode images, or hide anime for a more focused view.

Simalytics requires a Simkl account. Simalytics is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Simkl.
promotionalText: Track every movie, show, and anime in your Simkl library, stay current with Up Next, and discover what to watch from one focused companion.
whatsNew:
• Choose your default launch tab in Settings: Up Next, Lists, Explore, or Settings.
• Up Next now follows Simkl's watchlist data, keeping stale or unaired next episodes out of your queue. Mark watched with a full left swipe in supported layouts.
• Browse TV seasons and anime episode ranges with watched progress and a shortcut to the next unwatched episode. Resume from your latest watched season instead of returning to earlier seasons you skipped.
• Enjoy compact, steady episode rows, a cleaner scrolling header, and the original alignment for posters, title details, and watch status. Open full descriptions in a scrollable sheet, with improved support for larger text.
• Use native search, compact tabs while scrolling, and Liquid Glass detail controls on recent iOS versions. Episode lists support native full-swipe watch actions on iOS 27.
• Keep ten-star ratings on one line, select half-star ratings in five-star mode, remove ratings, and get clearer feedback when ratings or watched updates fail. Anime episode and title removals sync more reliably.
• Pan and zoom fullscreen posters, retry failed image loads, and receive confirmation when a poster finishes saving to Photos.
• Get clearer search loading and error states, better poster grids on smaller iPhones, and a clearer Reset & Sign Out action.
• Improved library loading, browsing performance, and recovery from connection or local storage errors. Refreshed the App Store screenshots to match the current interface.
